half_read: engine half (MMOEngine/src/engine/core: task queues, task manager, scheduler, worker). No game content in this donor. Paired donor: swgemu-Core3 (data pack).
count_notes: No game content. engine/core holds 21 headers and 15 sources (find). Whole-tree counts (538 .h, 166 .cpp) are from audit AU051, not recounted.

originals.name: Tick timer wheel for zone timers
originals.idea: One priority queue keyed by due time that holds respawn, despawn-grace and boss timers for every zone.
originals.keep: A priority queue keyed by execution time; a delay add that replaces an already queued task so no task is queued twice; waking the waiting thread when the new task is at the top (TimedTaskQueue.cpp lines 38, 42, 97).
originals.change: Our own timer types; the delay unit is confirmed in our code (not traced in the donor).

originals.name: Save-blocking side queue
originals.idea: A named side queue with its own worker count that pauses during a save, so a slow write never stalls the fight tick.
originals.keep: Named queues with their own thread counts and a save-event block default (TaskManagerImpl.h line 62).
originals.change: Our queues for world simulation and for I/O; no shared lock with the fight loop.

originals.name: Scheduler and worker split
originals.idea: Scheduler threads decide when work is due; worker threads do the work; I/O has its own scheduler set.
originals.keep: Separate worker, scheduler and I/O scheduler vectors (TaskManagerImpl.h lines 27, 28, 30).
originals.change: The hand-off between scheduler and worker is not traced in the donor; design it ourselves. Replace the one-millisecond poll (TaskScheduler.cpp line 84) with a timed wake-up.
